scope: All six applicant steps, existing outbound links, and routes for missing information or setbacks. Selected direct court coverage remains five counties.

steps.gap: Online record may omit a needed disposition or discharge document.
steps.resolution: Direct searches, record-request script, lookup guide and BCI fallback; require core case facts before step two.

steps.gap: Statute references alone did not provide a general eligibility tool or route for an unclear case.
steps.resolution: Linked general eligibility interview and action plan with account requirement; distinguished marijuana-specific route; legal-aid review and timing links.

steps.gap: Unlisted courts and older general forms could leave an applicant without an accepted packet.
steps.resolution: Court-specific applications, field guide, packet-confirmation script, example, worksheet and application-preparation help; no universal-form claim.

steps.gap: Needed actionable fee-waiver, accepted-filing, service and rejected-filing support.
steps.resolution: Official indigency forms fallback, local-form confirmation, filing questions, service responsibility and acceptance/receipt checklist.

steps.gap: Needed help when notice is missing, an objection arrives, or attendance/access is difficult.
steps.resolution: Docket and clerk confirmation, hearing prep, local accommodation requests, interpreter support, remote/continuance request instructions without presuming approval.

steps.gap: Generic follow-up did not explain correction or dispute channels, and legal aid may decline.
steps.resolution: Court order/agency checks, Attorney General correction instructions and BCI contact, separate FTC employment/rental dispute guides, lawyer-referral fallback and prompt denial review.

link_availability.method: GET of each distinct external HTML/PDF link; landing-page response is not proof of eligibility, full functionality, form acceptance or content freshness.
